correctness.rationale: The upper bound is furnished by an explicit threshold projection. For the lower bound, simultaneous coordinate-sign averaging preserves the graph and projection norm while eliminating off-diagonal blocks; the block equations A_n+λ_n B_n=I, together with the exact ℓ_q-to-ℓ_p block-multiplier norm, force the reciprocal tail estimate L_λ(2K)≤2K. Endpoint q=∞ uses the c_0-sum and the same finite-support multiplier argument.

originality.rationale: Classical qualitative splitting results for complemented unconditional subspaces of ℓ_p⊕ℓ_q are explicitly treated as prior art. Targeted searches did not locate the arbitrary-Banach-block two-sided threshold formula for the relative projection constant or the resulting sharp n^α finite-section phase diagram. Older direct-sum papers not inspected in full remain a documented residual risk.

value.rationale: The theorem converts graph complementability into a scalar tail functional independent of block geometry, supplies quantitative projection-constant bounds, and exhibits a re-entrant power-weight transition with polynomial and critical logarithmic finite-dimensional growth.
